summary.text: Thomas Hall is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 46 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A sales executive, he chairs the Government Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Hall lives in Madison Township, Ohio, and graduated from Madison High School in 2014, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree in small business management from Miami University, served as a board member with the Middletown Area YMCA, and has worked in sales and customer service.
Ballotpedia lists Hall's tenure in the Ohio House of Representatives as beginning in 2021, with his current District 46 term starting January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Government Oversight Committee and serves on the House Finance, Public Safety and Technology and Innovation committees.
Benjamin McCall (D) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
